::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/report_dashboards/{id}"}
#docs
The dashboard and its tiles, with NO reports resolved — use `/reports` for the answers. A dashboard you cannot see answers 404 rather than 403, so a private dashboard's existence never leaks.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The report dashboard's id. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such dashboard, or not visible to you |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/report_dashboards/dash_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such dashboard, or not visible to you"
  }
}
```
:::
::
